searchText: New EEST `devnet-1@v1.1.0` release: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/devnet-1%40v1.1.0 Adds the initial 7702 tests on top of the previous release. EEST now requires rust. Isn't this a bit too much? Why does it require rust? I think via `consensus-specs` dependency What is your guys perspective when including 7702 tx and the correctness of single authority tuples, when including in tx pool and block production? A 7702 tx is still valid despite having a tuple with bad chain id or nonce or even authority with code, but what is your view on filtering for these things before block execution (pool and production)
